en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a man who ordered his slave that he should kill a man, so he killed him. So Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And is a slave of the man anything except like his whip, or like his sword? The master would be killed due to it, and the slave would be left in the prison’.
